title: Finally, a Real Alternative to Confluence
intro: Outline is the fast, modern, alternative to Confluence that your team has been looking for – on-premises or in the cloud.

features.title: Great looking docs, without even trying.
features.description: An easy to use editor with markdown shortcuts, slash commands, and media embeds that looks great by default.

features.title: Access control & permissions.
features.description: Manage access to your knowledge base with read & write permissions, user groups, guest users, public sharing, and more…

features.title: Structured & instantly searchable.
features.description: Nest documents in a hierachy, automatically build a network of backlinks and search across everything in ms.

features.title: AI answers & built-in MCP.
features.description: Get instant answers from your knowledge base, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants to search, read, and edit docs with the built-in MCP server.

features.title: Cloud hosted or on-premises.
features.description: Outline is available as a cloud hosted service that’s always up-to-date or as a self-hosted install on your own network.

closing: On the same page as us? Let’s take your team’s writing to the next level…
